_about: Public-domain Cunningham Geikie (1824-1906), Anglican vicar and popular biblical writer, for the Word Hoard: The Life and Words of Christ (London, 1877, two volumes), The Holy Land and the Bible (Cassell, 1887, two volumes), Hours with the Bible in the complete six-volume American set (Alden, 1888-90) and The English Reformation (1879), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 36 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
